Author: CrownedPandaXIV
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description:
Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!

Subs and their routes, supplies, parts, retainers, Free Companies, inventories, income, the market and trends, all in the game. Keep your fleet on this PC with nothing else to install, or share it between PCs (and with the free Windows app) through a database. Type /xivfleet to start.

Needs:
• AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json)

Works best with:
• Allagan Tools: bags, retainers' items and FC chests
• FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf): FC houses
• Submarine Tracker: voyage loot

Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team (AutoRetainer), Critical_Impact (Allagan Tools), erdelf (FC Tracker) and Infi (Submarine Tracker) for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
Fixes to the Sub Calculator, the workshop readings and the market price, from a full check of 2.6.0.

### Faster
- Voyage Planner works out market prices only when they change, not every frame: with Live Market Prices on it cost up to 12 ms and 10 MB a frame.
- Route Finder and Compare Builds search only for the routes they show: "Any" on a 30-sector map takes a fraction of a second instead of several, with far less memory, and a new choice stops the search still running. With the list cut to the best 100, the count reads "The best 100 routes" (the full count shows when every route fits on the list).
- Game data that can't be read is tried again every 5 minutes, not every 2 seconds.

### Numbers
- Repair kits: a part can still sail until its condition reaches 0, so it lasts one voyage longer than shown before, and a repair is always a full one. Kits a day and "parts last" were up to 45% too high.
- Levelling Plan: a stage's Exp a voyage and Exp an hour are now its averages, not its first voyage's.
- Levelling Plan: the "not discovered yet" hint looks at every rank of a stage, and says the rank when it's later.
- Levelling Plan: when the parts can't fly any route at all, it suggests the one part swap that lets the sub level.
- Compare Builds: a build whose parts can't be fitted at its rank says so and gets no voyage numbers or green marks.
- Market price: the check against last week's sales no longer overrides three or more listings that agree: that's the market dropping, not a lone low listing. Undercuts show again on Gil & Market.
- Route Finder and Compare Builds price gil on the market with Live Market Prices on (your sub's data center), as the app does.
- Routes that tie exactly (same time and range) always come in the same order.

### Pages
- When a page's working out fails it says so in red, instead of showing the last answer as if it were current (Build Finder, Route Finder, Compare, Levelling Plan).
- Levelling Plan: going back to a choice while another is being worked out no longer shows the other's plan; a sub's target at or below its rank moves to the next rank up; the "not discovered yet" sentence wraps.
- Build Finder: the Rank column comes back when you sort by a column header; "Ones I own" counts any part (and says so) until your parts have been read, instead of showing no builds.
- Compare Builds: "must go to" sectors from another map no longer leave every build with "No route fits".
- Subs and Route Optimization: a "needs …" route stays on one line, so long lists don't lose their last rows.
- The amber part-swap lines stop at the table's edge, with the whole line on hover.
- Each page's sub picker keeps its own search.
- The "needs …" marks follow a character moving to another Free Company.
- Route Finder: "Working out the routes…" as on the other pages; "A must isn't a sector this sub can go to."; wording as the app's.
- Gil & Market: the columns read "Market on World/DC/Region"; the Settings hover no longer says the Shopping List uses that price.

### Workshop readings
- A reading taken before AutoRetainer knows the character's Free Company waits for a later sync instead of being lost for the session.
- Readings are filed under the Free Company whose workshop they were read in (as the game says), not the one AutoRetainer last had.
- Part condition isn't read while the game says the parts aren't loaded yet (it could still hold another workshop's).
- Sector readings from two PCs are merged (a sector, once explored, stays explored), so a PC whose clock is ahead can't hide another's newer reading.
- Removing a character also removes its part readings, and the sectors and part readings of a Free Company no one is left in. The Free Company pickers take each FC's world and accounts from all its characters, as the app does.
- Releases ship the Sub Calculator data the tests ran on, the same as the app's.
